stations.title: Practice database
stations.note: Most of them are noise on a call.

captions: Winnie wants a phone list with the names and numbers she needs, and the word surname.
Today every query brings back every column, and the numbers drown in emails and towns.
You choose and name the columns, and work out new ones, in four tasks.
Now the phone list has exactly the columns Winnie reads, under the names she uses.
Same tables, the right columns. Each list fits the question it answers.
